summary: Frontend regression of /pagamentos after the 4 requested improvements (row-click opens modal, in-modal actions Cobrar/Historico/Recibo, count-up KPIs with delta chip, visual consistency on /agenda and /dashboard). Verified end-to-end via Playwright on the public preview URL as adilsonsoares203@gmail.com. All primary flows PASS.
critical_code_review_comments: Pagamentos.js remains ~1200+ lines — extracting ParcelaRow, KpiCard, ConfirmacoesList, HistoricoTable to their own files is overdue per project's >700 lines guideline.

AnimatedNumber restarts from state.current.from (last committed value) — good for delta transitions; but on first mount from=0 causes a full 0→value sweep even if data was already loaded. Consider skipping animation on initial paint or when duration<50.

PagamentoDetalheModal exposes modal-acao-historico only when historico.length>0 (correct); it depends on the parent passing the historico array. Confirmed via code that Pagamentos.js filters pagamentos by parcela_id before passing — verify caching invalidation after a new payment so histórico opens with the latest entry (not exercised in this run).

Row-level onClick uses role='button' and stopPropagation on inner buttons — good a11y. Consider Enter/Space keydown on the row for keyboard users (currently role=button suggests it should be operable via keyboard).

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (7/7 primary flows PASS; recibo download button click + PDF response not fully exercised end-to-end)
